biggest_catch: Minimum 14-hour Election Day (6 AM-8 PM); training is required before every election but its duration is not published, so it is not counted in the time.
catches: Poll Manager and Poll Manager Assistant Stipend: $135.00.
Available to work a minimum of 14 hours on Election Day (6:00am to 8:00pm approximately).
Training before EVERY election is required for ALL positions (duration not published).
All workers paid within 45 days of election day or subsequent runoff.
Poll managers (18+) must be registered to vote in South Carolina; 16-17 year-olds can be assistants.

steps: Meet eligibility: registered to vote in South Carolina (18+) or 16-17 as assistant.
Register to attend an in-person onboarding as a poll manager.
Complete required training before the election.
Work Election Day: 6:00 AM-8:00 PM (minimum 14 hours).
timing: Minimum 14 hours on Election Day (6 AM-8 PM approximately); mandatory training duration is not published.
weasel_words: Mandatory training is required but its duration is not published, so no training time is counted in the 14-hour minimum.
The county also offers Clerk ($195) and Assistant Clerk ($165) stipends plus a bonus stipend of up to $50 for county/statewide elections; this route uses only the $135 Poll Manager stipend.
